question: de qué países son los comercios que más volumen liquidan
sql: SELECT m.trade_name, c.country_name, SUM(f.amount_eur_minor) AS total_volume FROM fact_payment_attempt f JOIN dim_merchant m ON f.merchant_sk = m.merchant_sk JOIN ref_country c ON m.country_code = c.country_code GROUP BY m.trade_name, c.country_name ORDER BY total_volume DESC LIMIT 10
